name: Insanity Potion
blurb: Active:  Singed empowers himself for some time with  bonus ability power,  bonus armor,  bonus magic resist,  bonus movement speed,  bonus health regen, and  bonus mana regen.

effects.description: Active: Singed empowers himself for 25 seconds with ability power, bonus armor, bonus magic resistance, bonus movement speed, bonus health regeneration, and bonus mana regeneration.
During this time, Poison Trail additionally applies Grievous Wounds for 1 second, which refreshes every 0.25 seconds while the poison persists.
